entities.summary: Elisa Maria Ramos Damião was a Portuguese politician. A member of the Socialist Party, she served in the Assembly of the Republic from 1987 to 1998 and in the European Parliament from 1998 to 2004. She died on 7 May 2022 at the age of 75.
